sections.description:
PUNJAB LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCIL RULES, 1974
PUNJAB LEGAL PRACTITIONERS
AND BAR COUNCIL RULES, 1974
(Amendment of R.5.3)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, Part III, 14th February, 2007]
No.21279, dated 4-11-2006.---In rule 5.3 of
the Punjab Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Rules, 1974,after existing
clause (e), the following Proviso shall be added:---
"provided that the
enrollment as an advocate of the High Court shall be subject to the applicant's
having qualified the Interview conducted by the Examination Committee of the
Punjab Bar council".
